summary: Iteration 35 - Comprehensive UI/UX testing of Review Master. All 7 platforms (Google, Facebook, Amazon, Flipkart, JustDial, Swiggy, Zomato) are properly displayed across landing page, demo dashboard, integrations page, and QR review page. Mobile navigation works correctly with visible Sign Out button. Demo flow works end-to-end.
passed_tests: Landing page loads correctly with all 7 platforms mentioned
Landing page shows dashboard preview with 1,847 reviews, 4.7 rating, 98% response rate
Landing page shows 7 connected platform icons (Google, Facebook, Amazon, Flipkart, JustDial, Swiggy, Zomato)
Demo button ('Try A Demo') works and navigates to dashboard
Demo dashboard shows correct stats (1847 reviews, 4.7 rating, 98% response rate, 7 platforms)
Demo dashboard shows reviews from multiple platforms (Google, Facebook, Swiggy, Zomato)
Mobile navigation - bottom nav bar shows correctly (Home, Reviews, Stats, QR, More)
Mobile menu opens when clicking 'More' button
Sign Out / Exit Demo button is visible and prominent in mobile menu (red gradient button)
Sign Out button works - redirects to landing page with 'Demo session ended' toast
Integrations page shows all 7 platforms with 'Connected' status
Integrations page platform icons are visible and recognizable
Integrations page containers are properly aligned without content being cut off
QR Review page shows all 7 platform options for posting reviews
QR Review page platform icons are visible and recognizable
Guest payment endpoint (/api/payment/guest/create-order) works without authentication
Payment config endpoint returns correct pricing for all plans
